screen.xporbtrails.title: XP Orb Trail Settings
screen.xporbtrails.preview_hint: The preview loops automatically; replay the pickup effect at any time
screen.xporbtrails.enabled.tip: Controls whether XP orb trails are rendered.
screen.xporbtrails.glow.tip: Uses brighter additive blending; disable it for softer colors.
screen.xporbtrails.color_mode.tip: Choose a solid color, two-color gradient, or animated rainbow.
screen.xporbtrails.save_preset.tip: Save the current start and end colors as a custom preset, up to 12.
screen.xporbtrails.width.tip: Adjusts the base width of the entire trail.
screen.xporbtrails.rainbow_speed.tip: Controls how quickly rainbow colors cycle over time.
screen.xporbtrails.lifetime.tip: How long points remain; higher values produce longer trails.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_fade.tip: Time taken for a trail to fade after its orb is collected.
screen.xporbtrails.smoothness.tip: Smoothly flows older trail points toward the orb.
screen.xporbtrails.motion_shift.tip: Moves the trail anchor backward when an orb travels quickly.
screen.xporbtrails.camera_push.tip: Moves the trail slightly toward the camera to avoid model overlap.
screen.xporbtrails.glow_strength.tip: Adjusts glow brightness; high values may push pale colors toward white.
screen.xporbtrails.tail_width.tip: Width farthest from the orb; zero creates a pointed tail.
screen.xporbtrails.middle_width.tip: Adjusts the center of the trail with smooth transitions to both ends.
screen.xporbtrails.shape_preset.tip: Quickly applies a taper, spindle, uniform, or hourglass shape; sliders remain editable.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash.tip: Creates a short expanding flash where an XP orb is collected.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash_strength: Adjusts the brightness and visibility of the pickup flash.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash_duration: Controls how long the flash takes to expand and disappear.
screen.xporbtrails.pickup_flash_size.tip: Adjusts the pickup flash radius; the default is intentionally subtle.
screen.xporbtrails.flash_style.tip: Choose a soft burst, six-axis starburst, or camera-facing expanding ring.
screen.xporbtrails.save_profile.tip: Saves settings from every page, up to 8 complete custom profiles.
screen.xporbtrails.delete_profile.tip: Deletes the selected custom profile; built-in profiles cannot be removed.
screen.xporbtrails.overwrite_profile.tip: Overwrites the selected custom profile with all current settings while keeping its name.
screen.xporbtrails.rename_profile.tip: Changes the selected custom profile's name.
screen.xporbtrails.range.tip: Trails beyond this distance are not rendered.
screen.xporbtrails.cap.tip: Maximum simultaneous trails; lower this for extreme performance cases.
